definition: A gene encoding a guanosine triphosphate (GTP)-binding protein (implicated in ribosome-associated quality control) in which biallelic loss-of-function or pathogenic variants cause Jaberi-Elahi syndrome (OMIM #617988), an autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental and neuroectodermal disorder characterized by intellectual disability, motor developmental delay, speech disorders, abnormal tone/reflexes, seizures, microcephaly, skeletal abnormalities, and visual impairment.

source.title: Clinical delineation of GTPBP2‐associated neuro‐ectodermal syndrome: Report of two new families and review of the literature
source.quote: The GTPBP2 gene encodes a guanosine triphosphate (GTP)-binding protein of unknown function. Biallelic loss-of-function variants in the GTPBP2 gene have been previously reported in association with a neuro-ectodermal clinical presentation in six individuals from four unrelated families.
